<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?import javafx.geometry.Insets?> <?import javafx.scene.control.Button?> <?import javafx.scene.control.ComboBox?> <?import javafx.scene.control.Label?> <?import javafx.scene.control.ListView?> <?import javafx.scene.control.TableColumn?> <?import javafx.scene.control.TableView?> <?import javafx.scene.control.TextField?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.HBox?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.Priority?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.Region?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.VBox?>
<BorderPane xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx/17" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml/1" fx:controller="MainController" prefWidth="1260" prefHeight="780" style="-fx-background-color: #f3f4f6;">
<left> <VBox spacing="12" prefWidth="230" style="-fx-background-color: #334155;"> <padding> <Insets top="20" right="16" bottom="20" left="16"/> </padding>
<Label text="Campus Event Booking" style="-fx-text-fill: white; -fx-font-size: 20px; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/> <Label text="Admin Dashboard" style="-fx-text-fill: #e2e8f0; -fx-font-size: 12px;"/>
<Button text="Users" onAction="#showUsers" maxWidth="Infinity"/> <Button text="Events" onAction="#showEvents" maxWidth="Infinity"/> <Button text="Bookings" onAction="#showBookings" maxWidth="Infinity"/> <Button text="Waitlist" onAction="#showWaitlist" maxWidth="Infinity"/>
<Region VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS"/>
<Button text="Save Data" onAction="#handleSave" maxWidth="Infinity" style="-fx-font-weight: bold;"/> </VBox> </left>
<center> <VBox spacing="14" style="-fx-background-color: #ffffff; -fx-background-radius: 10; -fx-border-color: #d1d5db; -fx-border-radius: 10;"> <padding> <Insets top="16" right="16" bottom="12" left="16"/> </padding>
<HBox spacing="10" style="-fx-background-color: #e2e8f0; -fx-background-radius: 8; -fx-padding: 10 12;"> <Label text="Campus Event Booking System" style="-fx-font-size: 16px; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #1e293b;"/> <Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/> <Label text="Welcome, Admin" style="-fx-text-fill: #475569;"/> </HBox>
<VBox fx:id="panelUsers" spacing="12" visible="false" managed="false"> <Label text="User Management" style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/>
<HBox spacing="10"> <TextField fx:id="txtUserId" promptText="User ID" prefWidth="150"/> <TextField fx:id="txtUserName" promptText="Name" prefWidth="200"/> <TextField fx:id="txtUserEmail" promptText="Email" prefWidth="240"/> <ComboBox fx:id="cmbUserType" promptText="User Type" prefWidth="150"/> <Button text="Add User" onAction="#handleAddUser"/> </HBox>
<TableView fx:id="tblUsers" prefHeight="560" style="-fx-background-radius: 6;"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="colUserId" text="User ID" prefWidth="140"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colUserName" text="Name" prefWidth="240"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colUserEmail" text="Email" prefWidth="280"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colUserType" text="Type" prefWidth="140"/> </columns> </TableView> </VBox>
<VBox fx:id="panelEvents" spacing="12" visible="false" managed="false"> <Label text="Event Management" style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/>
<HBox spacing="10"> <TextField fx:id="txtEventId" promptText="Event ID" prefWidth="120"/> <TextField fx:id="txtEventTitle" promptText="Title" prefWidth="220"/> <TextField fx:id="txtEventDate" promptText="Date/Time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM)" prefWidth="220"/> <TextField fx:id="txtEventLocation" promptText="Location" prefWidth="180"/> </HBox>
<HBox spacing="10"> <TextField fx:id="txtEventCapacity" promptText="Capacity" prefWidth="110"/> <ComboBox fx:id="cmbEventType" promptText="Event Type" prefWidth="170"/> <TextField fx:id="txtEventSpecific" promptText="Topic / Speaker / Age Restriction" prefWidth="280"/> <Button text="Create Event" onAction="#handleCreateEvent"/> <Button text="Cancel Selected" onAction="#handleCancelEvent"/> </HBox>
<HBox spacing="10"> <TextField fx:id="txtSearchTitle" promptText="Search by title" prefWidth="320"/> <ComboBox fx:id="cmbFilterType" promptText="Filter Type" prefWidth="160"/> <Button text="Search" onAction="#handleSearchEvents"/> <Button text="Clear" onAction="#handleClearSearch"/> </HBox>
<TableView fx:id="tblEvents" prefHeight="500" style="-fx-background-radius: 6;"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="colEventId" text="Event ID" prefWidth="95"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colEventTitle" text="Title" prefWidth="220"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colEventDate" text="Date/Time" prefWidth="180"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colEventLocation" text="Location" prefWidth="160"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colEventCapacity" text="Capacity" prefWidth="90"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colEventStatus" text="Status" prefWidth="120"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colEventType" text="Type" prefWidth="120"/> </columns> </TableView> </VBox>
<VBox fx:id="panelBookings" spacing="12" visible="false" managed="false"> <Label text="Booking Management" style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/>
<HBox spacing="10"> <TextField fx:id="txtBookingUserId" promptText="User ID" prefWidth="170"/> <TextField fx:id="txtBookingEventId" promptText="Event ID" prefWidth="170"/> <Button text="Create Booking" onAction="#handleCreateBooking"/> <TextField fx:id="txtCancelBookingId" promptText="Booking ID to Cancel" prefWidth="200"/> <Button text="Cancel Booking" onAction="#handleCancelBooking"/> </HBox>
<TableView fx:id="tblBookings" prefHeight="560" style="-fx-background-radius: 6;"> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="colBookingId" text="Booking ID" prefWidth="180"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colBookingUser" text="User" prefWidth="220"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colBookingEvent" text="Event" prefWidth="320"/> <TableColumn fx:id="colBookingStatus" text="Status" prefWidth="170"/> </columns> </TableView> </VBox>
<VBox fx:id="panelWaitlist" spacing="12" visible="false" managed="false"> <Label text="Waitlist Management" style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/>
<HBox spacing="10"> <TextField fx:id="txtWaitlistEventId" promptText="Event ID" prefWidth="180"/> <Button text="View Waitlist" onAction="#handleViewWaitlist"/> </HBox>
<ListView fx:id="lstWaitlist" prefHeight="580" style="-fx-background-radius: 6;"/> </VBox>
</VBox> </center>
<bottom> <HBox spacing="8" style="-fx-background-color: #e5e7eb; -fx-padding: 8 12; -fx-border-color: #d1d5db 0 0 0;"> <Label text="Status:" style="-fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-text-fill: #334155;"/> <Label fx:id="lblStatus" text="Ready" style="-fx-text-fill: #1f2937;"/> </HBox> </bottom> </BorderPane>
